name: Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing
certifications: EC-Council Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH v13, also branded CEH AI)
tools: A deliberately vulnerable lab (Metasploitable, DVWA, HackTheBox or TryHackMe)

beginner.summary: For aspiring penetration testers, security analysts and IT staff who want to learn offensive security lawfully. Covers ethics, law and rules of engagement, a safe lab with Kali Linux and vulnerable targets, the hacking methodology, passive and active reconnaissance, scanning and enumeration, vulnerability assessment, password attacks, exploitation with Metasploit, web application attacks from the OWASP Top 10, network sniffing, social engineering awareness, wireless basics, maintaining access, covering tracks and detection, AI in offensive security, and clear reporting. Prepares for the CEH v13 exam.
prerequisites: Understands TCP/IP networking, subnets and common ports
Comfortable on the Linux and Windows command line
Has basic scripting with Python or Bash
outcomes: Work legally within scope, rules of engagement and ethics
Run reconnaissance, scanning, enumeration and vulnerability assessment
Exploit common network and web weaknesses in a lab with Metasploit and Burp Suite
Document findings and write a clear penetration test report

days.topic: Ethical Hacking Overview: Hackers, Methodology and the CEH Framework
subtopics: What ethical hacking is and is not
Black hat, white hat and grey hat
The five phases: reconnaissance, scanning, gaining access, maintaining access and covering tracks
Types of assessment: black box, grey box and white box
The CEH v13 framework and AI additions
Offensive security roles and career paths
The cyber kill chain and MITRE ATT&CK
Course project overview: a scoped test of a lab company
days.lab_task: Map a sample breach to the five phases and to MITRE ATT&CK tactics, and list which assessment type fits three client situations.
checks: Each breach step maps to a phase and an ATT&CK tactic
Each situation has a justified assessment type
The difference between ethical and criminal hacking is explained
objectives: Use ATT&CK and the kill chain

days.topic: Law, Ethics and Rules of Engagement
subtopics: Data handling and privacy during tests
days.lab_task: Write a rules of engagement document and scope statement for the lab company, listing allowed targets, timing, data handling and escalation.
days.deliverable: Signed-off rules of engagement and scope
checks: Allowed and forbidden targets are listed clearly
Data handling and escalation rules are defined

days.topic: Building a Safe Lab with Kali Linux and Vulnerable Targets
subtopics: Vulnerable targets: Metasploitable, DVWA and OWASP Juice Shop
Practice platforms such as HackTheBox and TryHackMe
Keeping the lab offline from production
days.lab_task: Build an isolated lab with Kali and two vulnerable targets, take clean snapshots and confirm the lab cannot reach the internet or production.
checks: Kali reaches the targets on an isolated network
The lab cannot reach production or the internet
Clean snapshots exist for each VM

days.topic: Passive Reconnaissance and Open-Source Intelligence
days.lab_task: Gather passive intelligence on the lab company's public footprint without touching its systems, and build a profile of hosts, names and emails.
checks: Domains, hosts and emails are found passively
No active connection was made to the target

days.topic: Active Reconnaissance and Network Scanning with Nmap
days.lab_task: Discover live hosts and open services on the lab network with Nmap, run safe scripts and confirm findings against the passive profile.
checks: Live hosts and open ports are found
Scan results match or extend the passive profile

days.topic: Enumeration: Services, Shares, Users and Banners
days.lab_task: Enumerate shares, users and services on the lab targets, find default credentials and map the attack surface.
checks: Shares, users and services are listed
Default or weak credentials are identified
The attack surface is drawn from the findings

days.topic: Vulnerability Assessment and Scoring
subtopics: Vulnerability assessment compared with penetration testing
Vulnerability scanners such as OpenVAS and Nessus
days.lab_task: Run a vulnerability scan against the lab targets, validate three findings by hand, score them with CVSS and prioritise them.
checks: Three findings are confirmed by hand
Findings are ranked with CVSS and context

days.topic: Password Attacks: Cracking, Spraying and Hash Attacks
subtopics: Rainbow tables and why salting matters
days.lab_task: Capture password hashes in the lab, crack weak ones with Hashcat and a rule set, and run a controlled password spray.
checks: The spray finds a reused weak password
Defences for each weakness are listed

days.topic: System Hacking and Exploitation with Metasploit
subtopics: Setting options and running an exploit
days.lab_task: Exploit a known vulnerability on Metasploitable with Metasploit, gain a Meterpreter session and collect proof without damaging the target.
checks: A session is obtained on the target

days.topic: Post-Exploitation and Privilege Escalation
subtopics: Data of interest and proof of impact
days.lab_task: From a foothold, enumerate the host, escalate to administrator or root on one Windows and one Linux target and pivot to a second host.
checks: Higher privileges are gained on both hosts
A second host is reached through the foothold

days.topic: Web Application Hacking: The OWASP Top 10
days.lab_task: Map a vulnerable web application with Burp Suite and exploit broken access control, a SQL injection and a cross-site scripting flaw.
checks: The application's requests and parameters are mapped
Three OWASP Top 10 flaws are exploited
Each finding has impact and a fix

days.topic: SQL Injection in Depth
days.lab_task: Find and exploit a SQL injection in the lab, extract database contents with manual queries and with sqlmap, and write the fix.
checks: Database data is extracted as proof

days.topic: Network Sniffing and Man-in-the-Middle Attacks
subtopics: Defences such as encryption and port security
days.lab_task: Perform an ARP spoofing man-in-the-middle attack in the lab, capture cleartext credentials and show how encryption prevents it.
checks: Traffic is intercepted through ARP spoofing

days.topic: Social Engineering and Phishing Awareness
subtopics: Building a phishing email in a lab
Ethics and consent for social engineering tests
days.lab_task: Build a lab phishing campaign with a consenting test group, measure click and submit rates and recommend awareness improvements.
checks: The campaign sends a convincing lab phish
Click and submit rates are recorded
Awareness and technical defences are proposed

days.topic: Wireless Network Attacks
subtopics: Cracking pre-shared keys in the lab
Evil twin and rogue access points
days.lab_task: Capture a WPA2 handshake from a lab access point, crack a weak pre-shared key and demonstrate an evil twin, then recommend defences.
checks: A handshake is captured in monitor mode
A weak pre-shared key is recovered

days.topic: Evading Detection: Firewalls, IDS and Antivirus
subtopics: Why evasion must stay in scope
tools: Lab IDS such as Snort or Suricata
days.lab_task: Compare a noisy scan and a stealthier scan against a lab IDS, show which alerts fire and explain the trade-offs.
checks: Noisy and stealthy scans are run
IDS alerts for each scan are recorded
Trade-offs between stealth and safety are explained

days.topic: Maintaining Access and Covering Tracks
subtopics: Backdoors and scheduled tasks in the lab
Why testers should not destroy evidence
days.lab_task: Install an authorised persistence mechanism on a lab host, show how a defender would detect it and then remove it cleanly.
checks: Access survives a reboot in the lab
The persistence is found in logs or tools
The host is returned to a clean state

days.topic: AI in Offensive Security: Assisted Recon, Exploitation and Defence
subtopics: AI help with scripting and payloads
Limits and hallucinations of AI tools
Attacks on machine learning models in brief
AI in the CEH v13 curriculum
Recording AI use in a test
days.lab_task: Use an AI assistant to speed up reconnaissance and script a safe lab task, then check its output for errors and record where it helped and misled.
checks: AI speeds up a recon or scripting task
AI errors are found and corrected
AI use is documented for the report

days.topic: Penetration Test Reporting and Remediation
days.lab_task: Write a penetration test report for the lab engagement with an executive summary, rated findings, evidence and remediation advice.
checks: The executive summary is clear for non-technical readers
Each finding has steps, evidence and a rating
Each finding has practical remediation advice

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Scoped Penetration Test of the Lab Company
days.lab_task: Run an end-to-end scoped penetration test of the lab company from reconnaissance to a privileged foothold and a web finding, and deliver a full report.
checks: The test stays within the agreed scope
A privileged foothold and a web finding are achieved
The report rates findings and advises fixes

intermediate.summary: For penetration testers who run assessments across networks, web, Active Directory and cloud. Covers engagement planning, advanced reconnaissance and attack-surface mapping, exploitation and exploit development basics, Active Directory attacks, lateral movement and pivoting, advanced web and API testing, authentication and token attacks, cloud penetration testing on AWS and Azure, container and Kubernetes attacks, wireless and network attacks at depth, command-and-control frameworks, payload development and evasion, phishing campaigns, mobile basics, OSINT programmes, reporting at scale and OSCP-style preparation.
prerequisites: Has completed a basic penetration test from recon to exploitation
Comfortable with Linux, Windows and Python scripting
Understands Active Directory and web application basics
outcomes: Plan and run multi-domain penetration tests within clear rules
Attack Active Directory, web, API and cloud targets and move laterally
Build and deliver payloads with evasion using command-and-control frameworks
Report technical findings and prepare for OSCP-style exams

days.topic: Engagement Planning, Threat Modelling and Methodology Selection
subtopics: Engagement types: network, web, cloud, red team and purple team
Choosing a methodology such as PTES or OWASP
Rules of engagement for deeper tests
days.lab_task: Plan a multi-domain engagement for the lab company with a threat model, methodology choice, rules of engagement and a deconfliction plan.
checks: The threat model drives the test plan
Scope, timing and safety controls are defined

days.topic: Advanced Reconnaissance and Attack-Surface Management
days.lab_task: Build an automated recon pipeline for the lab company that discovers assets, fingerprints technologies and flags leaked secrets, then prioritise the surface.
checks: Assets and technologies are discovered at scale
Leaked secrets or risky endpoints are flagged
The surface is prioritised by risk

days.topic: Exploitation Techniques and Exploit Development
subtopics: Stack buffer overflows in a lab
Finding the offset and controlling execution
Protections: DEP, ASLR and stack canaries
When to buy, build or borrow exploits
days.lab_task: Exploit a simple stack buffer overflow in a lab binary, find the offset, control execution and run shellcode, then explain the protections that would stop it.
checks: Execution is controlled through the overflow

days.topic: Active Directory Attacks: Enumeration and Kerberos
subtopics: Active Directory from an attacker's view
Recording the path to domain admin
days.lab_task: Enumerate a lab Active Directory, find an attack path with BloodHound, perform Kerberoasting and reach domain admin through the path.
days.deliverable: Active Directory attack path to domain admin
checks: Users, groups and paths are enumerated
Domain admin is reached through a documented path

days.topic: Lateral Movement, Pivoting and Persistence in Networks
days.lab_task: Move laterally across three lab hosts, set up a pivot and SOCKS proxy to reach a segmented network and document the movement.
checks: A segmented host is reached through a pivot
The movement is mapped across hosts

days.topic: Advanced Web Application Testing
days.lab_task: Test a complex lab application, exploit server-side request forgery and a business logic flaw and chain two issues into a higher-impact attack.
days.deliverable: Advanced web findings with a chain
checks: Server-side request forgery and a logic flaw are exploited
Two issues are chained for greater impact

days.topic: API Penetration Testing: REST, GraphQL and Tokens
days.lab_task: Test a lab REST and GraphQL API for broken object-level authorisation, mass assignment and JWT weaknesses, and report the risks.
checks: A GraphQL or JWT weakness is exploited

days.topic: Authentication and Token Attacks
subtopics: Credential stuffing and spraying at scale
days.lab_task: Attack a lab authentication system with token forgery and a multi-factor bypass technique, then recommend hardening.
checks: A token is forged or manipulated

days.topic: Cloud Penetration Testing on AWS and Azure
subtopics: Cloud testing rules and provider policies
Logging and detection in the cloud
days.lab_task: Enumerate a lab cloud account, find an over-privileged role and escalate privileges through it, and report the misconfiguration.
checks: Cloud assets and roles are enumerated
Privilege escalation through a role is proven
The misconfiguration and fix are reported

days.topic: Container and Kubernetes Attacks
days.lab_task: Attack a deliberately vulnerable lab cluster, escape a container or abuse a service account to reach the node and recommend hardening.
checks: A container escape or service account abuse succeeds
Access reaches the node or another pod

days.topic: Command-and-Control Frameworks and Operations
subtopics: Open-source frameworks such as Sliver and Havoc
days.lab_task: Set up a command-and-control framework in the lab with a redirector, deploy an implant to a lab host and run tasks through an encrypted channel.
checks: An implant checks in through a redirector
Tasks run over an encrypted channel

days.topic: Payload Development and Antivirus Evasion
days.lab_task: Build a payload that bypasses a lab antivirus, measure detection against two engines and record the techniques and their limits.
checks: The payload runs on a lab host
Detection by lab defences is recorded

days.topic: Phishing Campaigns and Initial Access Operations
tools: Gophish or Evilginx in a lab
days.lab_task: Run a consented lab phishing operation that captures a session or credential and leads to initial access, then report the chain and defences.
checks: The lure reaches the test group
A credential or session is captured
Defences for each step are recommended

days.topic: Network and Wireless Attacks at Depth
subtopics: Bluetooth and other radios in brief
days.lab_task: Test segmentation with a VLAN hopping attempt and attack a lab WPA2 Enterprise network, then recommend network defences.
checks: Segmentation and access control are tested

days.topic: Mobile Application Penetration Testing
subtopics: Limits of a basic mobile test
days.lab_task: Analyse a vulnerable lab Android app statically and dynamically, find insecure storage and an insecure API call and report them.
checks: App traffic is intercepted and a flaw found

days.topic: OSINT Programmes and Threat-Informed Testing
days.lab_task: Build an OSINT profile of the lab company and map a likely adversary's behaviour to plan a threat-informed test.
checks: Intelligence covers people, company and technology
A likely adversary's behaviour is mapped
The test plan reflects the intelligence

days.topic: Reporting at Scale and Retesting
days.lab_task: Produce a report from a multi-domain engagement using a findings library, consistent risk scoring and a remediation tracker, then plan the retest.
checks: The report uses the library and scoring

days.topic: OSCP and Practical Exam Preparation
subtopics: Buffer overflow and privilege escalation practice
days.lab_task: Complete a timed practice box from enumeration to privilege escalation with full notes, then write the exam-style report.
checks: The box is fully compromised in time
The exam-style report meets the format

days.topic: Attacking CI/CD Pipelines and Developer Tooling
days.lab_task: Attack a lab CI/CD pipeline through an exposed secret and a poisoned pipeline step, reach the build agent and recommend hardening.
checks: A secret or pipeline step is abused
The build agent or artefact is compromised

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Multi-Domain Penetration Test with a Red Team Flavour
days.lab_task: Run a multi-domain test of the lab company from external recon through phishing to Active Directory and cloud compromise using command and control, and deliver a report.
checks: Access moves from external to domain and cloud
Command and control is used within scope
The report rates and explains the chain

advanced.summary: For senior penetration testers, red team leads and offensive security managers. Covers red team programme design and planning, adversary emulation with threat intelligence, custom tooling and implant development, advanced evasion against endpoint detection, defence evasion with AMSI and ETW, physical and social engineering operations, assumed-breach and purple teaming, Active Directory and hybrid identity attacks, attacking AI and machine learning systems, OT and IoT testing, cloud and container attacks at depth, supply chain attacks, operational security and infrastructure, metrics and maturity, legal and insurance considerations, building a team and reporting to executives.
prerequisites: Has run multi-domain penetration tests and used command-and-control frameworks
Strong Active Directory, cloud and scripting skills
Responsible for leading tests or an offensive team
outcomes: Design and lead red team and adversary-emulation programmes
Build custom tooling and evade modern endpoint and detection controls
Run purple teaming, physical operations and specialised tests including AI, OT and supply chain
Measure offensive maturity, manage legal risk and report to executives

days.topic: Red Team Programme Design and Operating Model
subtopics: Rules of engagement for red teams
days.lab_task: Design a red team programme for the lab company with governance, engagement cadence, objectives and metrics, and present it to a leadership persona.
checks: Governance and safety controls are defined
Engagement types and cadence are set

days.topic: Adversary Emulation with Threat Intelligence
days.lab_task: Build and run an adversary-emulation plan for a chosen threat actor against the lab, mapped to ATT&CK, and measure which techniques were detected.
checks: The plan matches the chosen adversary
Detection of each technique is recorded

days.topic: Custom Tooling and Implant Development
tools: A programming language such as Go or C#
days.lab_task: Extend an open-source implant or build a simple one with a custom command channel, test it against lab detection and document its indicators.
checks: The implant checks in and runs tasks
Detection by lab defences is measured

days.topic: Advanced Evasion: AMSI, ETW and Endpoint Detection
subtopics: How endpoint detection and response works
Testing against a lab endpoint product
days.lab_task: Run a technique that a lab endpoint product detects, apply AMSI and ETW evasion, and measure the change in alerts without leaving scope.

days.topic: Physical and Social Engineering Operations
subtopics: Safety and legal limits for physical tests
tools: Physical assessment kit in a lab
days.lab_task: Plan a physical and social engineering operation for a lab scenario with pretexts, a drop device plan and safety limits, and write the playbook.
checks: Pretexts and entry methods are planned
Safety and legal limits are defined

days.topic: Assumed-Breach and Purple Team Operations
subtopics: Running techniques with the blue team watching
days.lab_task: Run an assumed-breach purple team exercise where the blue team watches, record which techniques were detected and tune two detections together.
checks: Techniques are run from an assumed breach
Detection and response times are recorded
Two detections are tuned and retested

days.topic: Active Directory and Hybrid Identity Attacks at Depth
subtopics: Token theft and cloud lateral movement
Tier 0 protection from the attacker's view
days.lab_task: Attack a lab hybrid environment from an on-premises foothold to a cloud admin role through ADCS or token theft, then recommend tier 0 hardening.
days.deliverable: Hybrid identity attack path and hardening
checks: The path from on premises to cloud is proven
Each step maps to a detection opportunity
Tier 0 and hybrid hardening is recommended

days.topic: Attacking AI and Machine Learning Systems
subtopics: Training data and model poisoning concepts
The OWASP Top 10 for large language model applications
days.lab_task: Test a lab AI feature for prompt injection and insecure tool use, demonstrate a data leak and recommend defences.
checks: A prompt injection changes the AI behaviour
Defences for the AI system are recommended

days.topic: Operational Technology and IoT Testing
tools: A lab OT or IoT device
days.lab_task: Analyse a lab IoT device's firmware and traffic with passive and safe methods, find a weakness and recommend defences without disrupting the device.
days.deliverable: OT and IoT findings with defences
checks: Firmware or traffic reveals a weakness

days.topic: Cloud and Container Attacks at Depth
days.lab_task: Chain a cloud misconfiguration into cluster takeover in the lab, establish cloud persistence and report the chain with hardening.
checks: A chain from misconfiguration to takeover is proven
Hardening for each step is recommended
objectives: Attack clouds and clusters at depth

days.topic: Supply Chain and Software Attacks
days.lab_task: Compromise a lab build pipeline through a dependency or pipeline weakness, show the impact on the artefact and recommend supply chain defences.
checks: The pipeline or dependency is abused

days.topic: Operational Security and Red Team Infrastructure
days.lab_task: Stand up segregated red team infrastructure with redirectors and automation for a lab engagement, and document operational security controls.
days.deliverable: Red team infrastructure with operational security
checks: Operational security controls are in place

days.topic: Offensive Security Metrics, Maturity and Legal Considerations
days.lab_task: Build an ATT&CK coverage and detection-improvement report for the lab programme and review legal and insurance considerations for a cross-border test.
checks: Coverage and detection improvement are reported
Legal and insurance points are listed
Next steps for maturity are planned

days.topic: Advanced Initial Access Tradecraft
subtopics: Initial access vectors for mature targets
Payload delivery that evades mail defences
days.lab_task: Build an initial access chain that evades lab mail defences and captures a session, then map each step to a detection and defence.
checks: The lure evades lab mail defences
A session or token is captured
Each step has a detection and defence

days.topic: Malware Development and Loaders for Red Teams
subtopics: Keeping development lawful and in scope
tools: A programming language such as C# or Rust
days.lab_task: Build a lab loader that stages encrypted shellcode and injects into a process, test it against lab detection and document its indicators.
checks: The loader runs the staged payload
Detection by lab tools is measured

days.topic: Network Detection Evasion and Deception Awareness
subtopics: Protocol blending and domain fronting concepts
days.lab_task: Tune a beacon for stealthy network traffic, trigger a lab honey token on purpose to study deception and measure what network detection sees.
checks: A honey token is studied and documented

days.topic: Data Exfiltration Techniques and Detection
subtopics: Exfiltration goals and risks in a test
Channels: HTTPS, DNS and cloud storage
Proof of impact without real data
days.lab_task: Exfiltrate benign lab marker files over two channels within scope, show what data loss prevention detects and recommend defences.
checks: Marker files leave over two channels
Data loss prevention results are recorded

days.topic: Long-Haul Operations and Persistence at Scale
days.lab_task: Plan a long-haul operation with resilient persistence and fallback channels across several lab hosts, run a shift handover and track all actions.
checks: All actions are logged for the report

days.topic: Breach and Attack Simulation and Automation
subtopics: Feeding results to the blue team
tools: An open-source breach and attack simulation tool
days.lab_task: Automate a set of ATT&CK techniques with a breach and attack simulation tool in the lab, compare the results with a manual run and report coverage.
checks: Automated and manual results are compared

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Full-Scope Red Team Operation with Executive Reporting
days.lab_task: Lead a full-scope red team operation against the lab company with objective-based access, command and control, identity and cloud compromise, a purple team debrief and both executive and technical reports.
days.deliverable: Red team operation with executive and technical reports
checks: The objectives are achieved within scope
A purple team debrief improves detections
Executive and technical reports are delivered
